problems: Framing: the long pole runs far forward and down to the ground, which stretches the hero's bounding box. As a result the wagon sits small in the upper left with a large empty dirt foreground, instead of being framed on the body and wheels. The pole should be left out of the framing so the box, wheels and cover fill the card.

The canvas cover reads as a solid closed loaf. Neither end shows an opening or any bow it is stretched over, so it looks like a white block on the box rather than a canvas cover over hoops. Each end needs a wooden bow along its edge and a dark inner face set just inside, so the ends read as open.

The dark inside face at each open end of the cover is a full disk. Its lower half hangs out below the box body as a grey half-disk between the front wheels, under the body near the pole. It needs to be clipped flat at the top of the body, the way the cover is.
